purpose: Supplemental source audit; original strict scores remain unchanged
additional_cases: Every case with any strict failure or uncertainty in the complete primary study; inspect all five answers in each selected case
selection_rule: The random sample is chosen without filtering by outcomes. Union it with all flagged cases after primary review finishes.
audit_blinding: Source auditors receive source tasks and all five answers under new opaque labels, without condition names, authored invariants, primary ratings, proposed fixes, or the unblinding key.
resource_rule: Begin agent audits only after all four live CLI benchmark workers finish; at most three audit agents plus the root agent.
limitations: This supplemental plan was created after generated answers and some primary ratings were available; it is not a preregistered primary endpoint.
Source auditors are implementing model assistants from the same model family, not independent human or native-speaker reviewers.
Auditors did not author their assigned locale cases; this does not establish independent professional language review.
The sample can expose shared reviewer blind spots but cannot certify all generated answers or future reliability.
